items.question: What limitations of place, time, or vessel constrain the communal ritual drinking and eating?
premises: No restriction of place and time applies.
The absence of these restrictions holds in the same manner.
items.inference: The communal ritual drinking and eating proceed without constraints of place, time, or vessel.
items.plain_english: There is no restriction of place or time, and likewise no restriction of vessel.
